summary: Parkland kerb on Douglas Street where cars park; apartments 20 m away across the road.
reasons: Backs onto treed park, no homes behind

best_section.where: East kerb of Douglas Street, beside the treed park opposite the apartment blocks

drivers.traffic: Quiet side street off a larger road at the north end; some through traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars are parked along the street in both images, so a van blends in.
